question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

She decided to file a complaint with HR after being __harrasad __by her supervisor for several weeks.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"harassed"** means to subject someone to aggressive pressure or intimidation. (परेशान करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt **harassed** by the constant phone calls from telemarketers.
 
 
 
• **"Harassed" **is the **correct spelling** of the word in the given sentence. (परेशान किया गया)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **harassed** by his peers for his unique fashion sense.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: '**Option 2**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
